scenes.text: This tutorial covers Plate Queue. Chain multiple plates through the same validated pipeline.
Open Plate Queue from the Data and batch runs section. Add plate sources and choose the shared module sequence and settings preset.
In the main configuration area, review plate order, per-plate overrides, worker limits, failure policy, resume behavior, and output roots.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. start with a small plate or test field, then let the queue process plates sequentially with visible status.
When the workflow finishes, each plate receives an isolated project and run record while the queue preserves overall progress.
